g.text: Survival of the checked departure window: share of villages and care facilities with a checked route
Green = the survival of the checked departure window (no origin had a gap: the share checked at a departure time equals the share whose leave-by deadline is at or after it).

Model-relative results for recorded 2025 fire scenarios (4 scenario members per input time, drawn per cell from the forecast; 1-hour horizon; OSM roads at an assumed 40 km/h, no congestion). Not evacuation
outcomes. Planning aid only - not for live evacuation operations.
